summary: Phase 1 NodeOne multi-tenant rebrand tested end-to-end. New file /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_multitenant.py has 12 tests, all PASS (login/me/plan, parent register clones 18-product catalog + fresh central_stock, parent register duplicate 409, invite+partner register full flow, reuse invite -> 400, invalid invite -> 400, partner data isolation: /collaborators count=1, /central-stock 403, POST /products 403, POST /collaborators 403, POST /orders cross-partner 403, second parent org isolation of collabs+products+orders, central-stock flow: 18 rows + reception + consignment deducts central/adds partner + insufficient->400, regression products CRUD, clients CRUD + dup 409, orders create + 2x partial payments -> Partial then Finalizat + delete restores stock, dashboard + monthly scoped). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Login screen renders dark NodeOne hero + both go-register-parent / go-register-partner buttons. /register has tab-parent / tab-partner segmented control + reg-org-input / reg-invite-input / reg-email-input / reg-password-input / register-submit. Created throwaway parent test_ui_*@test.ro which successfully landed on fresh (tabs) dashboard with all 4 tabs (Panou, Comenzi, Produse, Parteneri) and zeroed KPIs. Real parent login works, 'open-account' header icon opens Cont screen showing 'FIRMA MAMA' role badge + 'open-depozit' row. Depozit Central shows 2 KPIs (0 IN DEPOZIT / 262 LA PARTENERI), opens RECEPTIE MARFA modal with rec-stepper (18 per-product rows) + submit-reception. Colaboratori list has add-collab-button (parent only). MOD SHOP SRL row -> collaborator detail shows gen-invite (Key) + add-consignment (+) + export-collab-pdf. Tapping gen-invite popped the 'COD INVITATIE' modal with invite-code='2METXEVVZRIT', close-invite, invite-done. Produse tab has add-product-button for parent. No React Native red screens, no console errors beyond the expected Metro websocket warning. No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) detected. Cleanup verified via Mongo: 0 leftover @test.ro users, 0 TEST_ orgs, 0 TEST_PV consignments, 0 TEST_ clients/orders/products; parent org restored to central_stock total=0, MOD SHOP total_stock=262 (= pre-test value), 18 products, 2 collaborators (MOD SHOP SRL + DETERGENT ZILNIC, both pre-existing before this iteration).

minor.issue: 4 legacy tests in test_iter3.py / test_iter5.py / test_iter5_date.py assume the pre-Phase-1 behavior where consignments did not need central stock. They now fail with 400 'Stoc central insuficient' because Phase 1 correctly requires reception first. The new iter6 tests cover the new contract. These legacy tests should be updated to do a reception call before the consignment (one-line add). Not a product bug.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Update test_iter3.py::TestConsignments::test_create_consignment_increments_stock_and_records_entry, test_iter5.py::test_consignment_increments_stock, test_iter5_date.py::test_consignment_with_explicit_date_persists_and_increments_stock, test_iter5_date.py::test_consignment_without_date_defaults_to_now to call POST /api/central-stock/reception for the required qty BEFORE calling POST /api/collaborators/{id}/consignments. This brings them in line with the Phase 1 central-stock-first contract. Backend code itself is correct and iter6 tests validate the new behavior.

(Nit) Review request text mentions 'Account tab (cont)' — in the actual UI Cont is NOT a bottom tab, it is reached via the top-right 'open-account' UserCircle icon on the dashboard header. UI is fine; just a wording difference. No change needed unless main agent intended a dedicated Cont tab.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 391 register_parent correctly clones all 18 CATALOG products with new UUIDs scoped to the new org, inserts a fresh central_stock dict, and returns a working JWT; isolation verified in iter6.
server.py line 422 /auth/invites requires parent via dependency AND re-validates the collaborator belongs to the org via collab_query — belt-and-suspenders, good.
server.py line 444 register_partner uses find_one_and_update atomic swap with used_at:None condition to guarantee single-use (prevents race condition on reuse) — correct implementation.

server.py line 739 create_consignment correctly ATOMICALLY reads+decrements central and increments partner stock in one request; however deduction and partner update happen in sequential update_one calls without a transaction — if the second update fails after the first succeeds the central would be debited without crediting the partner. Low risk on single mongo instance but should be noted. Consider wrapping in a session.start_transaction() when mongo is replica set.
server.py line 796 central_reception has no row-level error isolation if one qty==0 the item is skipped but if the whole list is empty you get 400 ('Nu ai adaugate produse'). Good.

server.py line 791 total_consigned aggregates across ALL partner stock values, which includes negative stock (over-sold). On an org with -22 Odorizant this makes total_consigned smaller than reality. Minor cosmetic — current dashboard shows '262 buc' which already reflects the net. Not a bug.
server.py has grown to 1203 lines — same recommendation from iter4/iter5: split into routers/ sub-modules (auth, products, collaborators, orders, dashboard).
colaborator/[id].tsx line 101/104 wire gen-invite and add-consignment on the header for parent only; partner view hides them — matches backend 403 guards. Good.
login.tsx renders Image hero with LinearGradient scrim and dark theme c.surface — looks correct, dark navy theme consistent across all screens tested.
No HTML tags, all text wrapped in <Text>, StyleSheet via makeStyles(), SafeAreaView usage consistent.
